title: Endogenous Information Design and Informational Evolution in Dynamic Economic Systems with Incentives and Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.36093v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper studies the endogenous informational evolution of dynamic economic systems. Building on Hurwicz's conceptual framework, such a system is defined as a dynamic joint adjustment process of resource and information allocation linked by recursive feedback. Economic theory gains precision by isolating particular margins, but when information production, disclosure, learning, incentives, actions, and future feasibility interact across these two processes, conclusions obtained by holding other margins fixed need not survive their joint determination. The paper develops a system-level dynamic equilibrium framework for this interaction. Holding particular links fixed yields familiar environments in dynamic mechanism design, information design, experimentation and learning, feedback and disclosure, and information acquisition. The analysis establishes three central failures relative to fixed or partially exogenous informational environme

translated_title: 具有激励与学习的动态经济系统中的内生信息设计与信息演化
translated_abstract: 本文研究动态经济系统的内生信息演化。基于赫维茨的概念框架，此类系统被定义为由递归反馈联系起来的资源配置与信息配置的动态联合调整过程。经济理论通过隔离特定边际而获得精确性，但当信息生产、披露、学习、激励、行动与未来可行性在这两个过程中相互作用时，在固定其他边际条件下得出的结论在联合决定下未必仍然成立。本文为这种相互作用构建了一个系统层面的动态均衡框架。若固定其中特定环节，该框架可还原为动态机制设计、信息设计、实验与学习、反馈与披露以及信息获取等人们熟悉的环境。相对于信息环境固定或部分外生的情形，本文的分析揭示了三个核心失灵现象。
tldr: 本文构建了一个系统层面的动态均衡框架，研究信息生产、披露、学习与激励如何通过递归反馈在动态经济系统中内生地共同演化，并揭示了相对于信息环境外生固定的标准结论所出现的三个核心失灵。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a system-level dynamic equilibrium framework in which information production, disclosure, learning, and incentives co-evolve endogenously through recursive feedback in dynamic economic systems, identifying three central failures of conclusions derived under fixed or partially exogenous informational environments.
